te: Forum on the role of ISOC on 26 August prepared, and the discussion with the Royal Thai Survey Department noted
se: The meeting noted the preparations for the academic forum "Sustainable Internal Security Management: The Role and Direction of the Internal Security Operations Command in an Integrated Dimension" on 26 August 2026 in Meeting Room 402–403, Parliament House, and noted the outcome of the discussion with the Director of the Royal Thai Survey Department on ways to help 40 families farming in the area of the Thai–Myanmar border in Cho Po Ro Subdistrict, Kra Buri District, Ranong Province
it: Preparations for the academic forum "Sustainable Internal Security Management: The Role and Direction of the Internal Security Operations Command in an Integrated Dimension", 26 August 2026
Outcome of the discussion with the Royal Thai Survey Department on helping 40 families, Kra Buri District, Ranong Province

te: Readiness of the Volunteer Defence Corps to respond to security threats and disasters
se: The meeting considered the role of the Volunteer Defence Corps in keeping order and responding to threats and disasters locally, such as staffing frameworks that do not yet suit local needs, especially in border provinces, readiness in equipment and technology, training, and the welfare of volunteers, and noted the issues for discussion with the Director of the Volunteer Defence Corps and for a study visit
it: The role and readiness of the Volunteer Defence Corps in responding to security threats and disasters

te: Questions to the executive on the Ranong–Chumphon border confirmed, and forum speakers prepared
se: The meeting approved questions to the Minister of Defence, the Permanent Secretary for Interior, the Secretary-General of the National Security Council and the Director-General of the Department of Treaties and Legal Affairs on the approach taken in the area of the Thai–Myanmar border, with all subcommittee members to join the committee's meeting, and approved the topics for 5 speakers at the seminar on the internal security law
it: Questions to policy-level agencies on the Thai–Myanmar border in Ranong and Chumphon Provinces
Seminar to hear views on the draft study report on the Internal Security Act B.E. 2551 (2008)

te: Questions on the approach on the Ranong–Chumphon border, the forum project, and a framework for studying foreign nationals in Pai approved
se: The meeting approved questions to the executive on its position and approach in the area of the Thai–Myanmar border in Ranong and Chumphon Provinces, proposing short-term measures to ease the hardship of 40 families and, in the long term, clear demarcation of the boundary. It approved the draft project for a forum on the internal security law, and approved a framework for studying security management concerning foreign nationals in Pai District, Mae Hong Son Province
it: Questions on the approach in the area of the Thai–Myanmar border, Ranong and Chumphon Provinces
Draft project and schedule of the seminar to hear views on the draft study report on the Internal Security Act B.E. 2551 (2008)
Security management concerning foreign nationals in Pai District, Mae Hong Son Province

te: Forum project on the role of ISOC approved, and questions to the executive on Ranong villagers prepared
se: The meeting approved the academic forum project for fiscal year 2026, "Sustainable Internal Security Management: The Role and Direction of the Internal Security Operations Command in an Integrated Dimension", and considered a matter referred by the committee concerning 40 families farming in the area of the Thai–Myanmar border in Cho Po Ro Subdistrict, Kra Buri District, Ranong Province, assigning in-depth questions to be prepared to request information from the Minister of Defence, the Permanent Secretary for Interior, the Director-General of the Department of Treaties and Legal Affairs and the Secretary-General of the National Security Council on 20 July 2026
it: Academic forum project "Sustainable Internal Security Management: The Role and Direction of the Internal Security Operations Command in an Integrated Dimension"
Matter referred by the committee: 40 families farming in the area of the Thai–Myanmar border, Cho Po Ro Subdistrict, Kra Buri District, Ranong Province

te: Questions set before a joint meeting with agencies on the Ranong border
se: The meeting considered questions on maintaining border security while helping people who farm in border areas, ahead of a meeting that afternoon with 12 agencies, such as the Royal Thai Survey Department, the Department of Lands, the 4th Army Area, the Governor of Ranong, the Ranong Customs House and the Ranong Provincial Agricultural Extension Office, and resolved that subcommittee members attend
it: Questions on border security and help for farmers in border areas

te: Discussion with agencies on boundary lines and help for border farmers prepared
se: The meeting prepared a joint meeting on 16 June 2026 with the agencies concerned, such as the Royal Thai Survey Department, the Department of Lands, the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation, the Department of Treaties and Legal Affairs, GISTDA and local military units, on maintaining border security while helping people who farm and face hardship because the boundary line is unclear, and noted the progress of the working groups
it: Preparations for the joint meeting with mapping, land and security agencies, 16 June 2026
Progress of the working groups: strategy for organising border areas, and holding an academic seminar

te: Work plans set for all 4 working groups, and the matter of Kra Buri villagers followed up
se: The meeting considered the action plans of the working groups: studying the management system of ISOC and a strategy for organising border areas, holding an academic forum on the internal security law, and receiving matters from those affected. It assigned the matter of bringing the produce of 40 families in for sale in Cho Po Ro Subdistrict, Kra Buri District, Ranong Province, and noted the survey of Thai–Myanmar boundary markers
it: Action plans of the working groups (study of ISOC and border organisation, academic forum, receiving complaints)
Survey of Thai–Myanmar boundary markers, and the matter of produce from 40 families, Kra Buri District, Ranong Province

te: Framework, border organisation strategy and study visit schedule for Sa Kaeo, Ranong and Chumphon approved
se: The meeting approved the subcommittee's work framework, approved in principle the study of a strategy for organising border areas, and approved the schedule of study visits on border land problems on the Thai–Cambodian border in Sa Kaeo Province and on the overlapping area of the Thai–Myanmar border in Ranong and Chumphon Provinces
it: The subcommittee's work framework
Study of a strategy for organising border areas
Schedule of the study visit to Sa Kaeo Province
Schedule of the study visit to the overlapping area of the Thai–Myanmar border, Ranong and Chumphon Provinces

te: Report on the internal security law, and study visits on border land problems in Sa Kaeo and Ranong prepared
se: The meeting approved the draft report on the study of the Internal Security Act B.E. 2551 (2008), with views to be heard from policy and operational agencies. It resolved to travel to study the land problems of people along the Thai–Cambodian border in Thap Thai Subdistrict, Ta Phraya District, and Ban Nong Chan, Sa Kaeo Province, as assigned by the committee, and the problems of the overlapping area in Kra Buri District, Ranong Province
it: Draft report on the study of the Internal Security Act B.E. 2551 (2008)
Land problems of people along the Thai–Cambodian border, Sa Kaeo Province (referred by the committee)
Overlapping area problems and security, Kra Buri District, Ranong Province

te: Draft report on the study of the internal security law approved
se: The meeting followed up progress in preparing the report on the study of the Internal Security Act B.E. 2551 (2008) and approved the draft report for submission to the committee
it: Draft report on the study of the Internal Security Act B.E. 2551 (2008)

te: Security agencies heard on the Thai–Myanmar border, together with the committee
se: The meeting considered the issues and effects for Thailand of the announced establishment of the Republic of Kawthoolei, and approved all subcommittee members and advisers joining the meeting of the Committee on Military Affairs and State Security that day, to which representatives of security agencies were invited to clarify
it: Issues and effects for Thailand concerning the Thai–Myanmar border
Date of the next meeting

te: Security agencies to be invited to clarify the situation on the Thai–Myanmar border
se: The meeting considered the security situation on the Thai–Myanmar border concerning the announced establishment of the Republic of Kawthoolei or other groups, and the readiness of state agencies, and approved inviting representatives of the Office of the National Security Council, the National Intelligence Agency, the Ministry of Defence, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Interior, the Royal Thai Police, the Royal Thai Army and the Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters to clarify before the committee on 19 January 2026
it: Security situation on the Thai–Myanmar border, and the readiness of state agencies to respond

te: Work plan for 2026 approved, and study visits to Betong and Pattani prepared
se: The meeting approved its work plan for 2026, pending observations from the working groups for a further revision, approved the schedule of study visits to Betong District, Yala Province, and Pattani Province on 14–17 January 2026, and appointed additional advisers
it: The subcommittee's work plan for 2026
Schedule of study visits to Betong District, Yala Province, and Pattani Province, 14–17 January 2026
Appointment of advisers to the subcommittee (additional)
Proposal from the Senators Meet the People project, southern group (lower south)
